data.name: PANZERKAMPF®
data.detailed_description:
Panzerkampf is a PvP team tank game with tank battles from World War II. You will play with historically accurate tanks and also experimental tanks that existed as concept ideas. Modern era tanks will come into play later on as well.

Key aspects of the game are the emphasis on a balanced game setup (no Pay2Win!), excellent gameplay and a clean and intuitive user interface.

Panzerkampf is free to play.

CHOOSE A TANK AND GET INTO THE BATTLE

Select your tank, load up your ammo and equipment, give your crew members their daily orders and go directly into battle!

BEGIN UPGRADING PARAMETERS AND POLISHING APPEARANCE OF YOUR TANKS

Upgrade your guns, engines and other parameters as you fight. Send members of your crews to regular training exercises. Between battles, you will also be able to apply various camouflages, stickers, and badges to your tanks in the future.

PLAY YOUR OWN PERSONAL TANK BATTLES OR FIGHT SIDE BY SIDE WITH FRIENDS

Call to battle from your tank for yourself, or connect with friends in the game by simply counting down and entering the same battle. We are working on the option to form a platoon together and join a clan (tank brigade), which will allow you to cooperate in battles to achieve the highest number of victories, communicate with each other, or fight with other friends!

IMPROVE YOUR COMBAT SKILLS

Advance through battles, gain combat experience, improve your personal stats and fearlessly climb the in-game leaderboards. We will also be introducing new game modes later on, such as Death Match, Flag Conquest, and more!

FIGHT IN AN ENVIRONMENT RENDERED WITH THE MOST MODERN TECHNOLOGY

The game uses state-of-the-art High Definition Rendering Pipeline. Tank models and environments are highly detailed. Particle effects use advanced animation and rendering techniques. The tank sounds are those of real tank engines and weapons, including of course the legendary German 88!

data.short_description: World war of tanks rages on. Join the battle in one of our real-world tanks! Upgrade your vehicles and destroy the enemy! Play with friends and dominate the war! Play for free, in intuitive and easy to grasp UI, with state-of-the-art graphics, particle effects and authentic sound!
data.supported_languages:
English*, German*, Czech, Hungarian, Polish, Slovak
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 4-6 core CPU from AMD or Intel
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX980 or RX580 class GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: MB embedded
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 5600 or Intel i5-12400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060ti or RX 6800 class GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: MB embedded
